resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref list (egpc.com.eg legacy page, petrojet, youm7 2021, gate.ahram) mostly dead, but two of these are actually live and support the value: Youm7 2021-12-19 names it a 'خط نقل السولار' (diesel/gas-oil transport line); EGPC's own official 'Operation Projects (In Progress)' page lists this exact line ('Sokhna/ Hafayer/ Wadi Hagoul PL 30"/42 km') under the header 'Crude oil/ Fuel oil pipelines upgrade at PPC'. Both independently describe it as carrying a liquid petroleum product (diesel vs. crude/fuel oil) -- both fall under the sheet's generic Fuel='Oil, oil products', so counted as two agreeing independent sources for that classification, though they differ on which specific product predominates.

Youm7 2021-12-19 states the Sokhna/Hafayer/Wadi Hagool diesel line is 'تم التشغيل' (has been put into operation). Independently, the Ministry of Petroleum's own PDF 'مشروعات خطوط الخام والمنتجات البترولية' (fetched directly, live -- the brief's DEAD_LINK class for this exact URL on the P7321 shard's units did not hold up either) lists 'خط خام السخنة / الحفاير / وادى حجول' under 'الخطوط التي تم تنفيذها' (lines that have been completed/put into service) for 2014/15-Jan 2023. The verifier's automated content check FAILed on this PDF because its text is embedded in compressed streams the screen cannot extract (same known limitation as the P3693 shard's PDF); hand-confirmed via pdftotext -- ok/contains_value recorded true on that manual read. Two independent sources agree the line is operating.

Egypt Oil & Gas feature article states verbatim: 'Egypt constructed the Ain Sokhna/Wadi hagool/ Al-Hafayer pipeline with investments EGP219.2 million in 2018' -- exact match to StartYear1=2018 (and to Cost, see that unit). No other source found giving a specific year for this line (Youm7 2021 only confirms it is already operating by then, without a construction/start year); kept medium/single-source.

EGPC's official 'Operation Projects (In Progress)' page lists 'Sokhna/ Hafayer/ Wadi Hagoul PL 30"/42 km' -- exact match to LengthKnown=42.00 km. Youm7 2021-12-19 gives a conflicting figure for the same line ('بطول 41 كم' / 41 km) -- per the no-orphan-support rule this disagreeing figure is NOT cited as support (it would not raise this to a 2-source/high tier); recorded here as a live disagreement rather than acted on. petrojet.com.eg/project-details/58 (seed citation) is a JS single-page app whose raw HTML carries no project text at all (confirmed by direct fetch: no mention of Sokhna/Hagoul/pipe anywhere in the served markup) -- unusable, not counted as a source either way.

Same EGPC listing, 'Sokhna/ Hafayer/ Wadi Hagoul PL 30"/42 km' -- exact match to Diameter=30in. The current_ref (petrojet.com.eg/project-details/58) is a JS SPA shell with no server-rendered project content (checked directly, no mention of this pipeline anywhere in the raw page); could not be used as a second source. Kept medium/single-source.

Egypt Oil & Gas feature: 'Egypt constructed the Ain Sokhna/Wadi hagool/ Al-Hafayer pipeline with investments EGP219.2 million in 2018' -- EGP219.2 million = exactly 219,200,000 EGP, matching the sheet. EGPC's official page gives only a combined 'expected cost of about LE 1.4 bn' for the whole 4-line upgrade bundle (ElMax/Damanhor, Sokhna/Tebbin, Tebbin/South Helwan, and this line together), not a per-line figure, so it cannot corroborate this specific value. Kept medium/single-source.
